settings.heading: A Word From Mark
settings.sub_heading: Welcome to Flooret. Prepare to be Floored.
settings.content:
Meet Mark Blain, our VP of Installations and leader of our nationwide Installation Services Program.

Welcome to the nationwide network of Flooret Worry-Free Installation. I'm excited to team with you and grow our installation network. 

I always say, “Floors are only as good as the install-and the install is only as good as the floor.” This is the reason Flooret is looking for experienced, quality craftsmen to build our network. Our desire is to serve our customers with not only the best floors, but also a top-notch installation and customer experience that will last a lifetime. In both my work life and personal pursuits, I’ve found that the basics and the fundamentals are ALWAYS the most important, and sometimes the most overlooked things that lead to success.

settings.usp_title: Knowledgeable Support, Exclusive Products, and Projects Ready To Start
settings.usp_content: Our Installer program is engineered to support the business needs of Installers. Benefits include dedicated support, access to exclusive, members-only products, qualified leads for jobs, and more.
Secure exclusive pricing on all your purchases and no order minimums as a token of our dedication to your business growth and partnership with Flooret.
Set your own prices for your services and accept jobs on your schedule.
In addition to free samples of individual planks, you can also order convenient Sample Kits to try out countless possibilities, all at no cost to you.
